flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ then Open the first product and store its displayed price as listed_price.
Get the displayed price of the first product and save as {{listed_price}}.
Add it to the cart without any extras.
If the cart contains anything else you did not add, @v16:"remove it".
Go to checkout and continue until the final order review page, filling any required fields with simple test text.
Do not enter payment details and do not place the order.
Store the final order total shown on the review page as final_total, and store the names of any fees added on top of {{listed_price}} as extra_fees (or "none").
Get the final order total shown on the review page and save as {{final_total}}.
Get the names of any fees added on top of {{listed_price}} and save as {{extra_fees}}.
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

remark: click: Clicking View deal in the first product card
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the AirWave Pro Earbuds product detail page to load
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'the displayed price of the first product is saved as {{
click: Clicking Add to cart to add the first product without extras
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the cart page to load
analyze: the cart contains anything else you did not add
click: Clicking Remove for ShieldPlus Protection Plan in cart
wait: Waiting after removing the unwanted cart item
click: Clicking Checkout in your cart summary
wait: PRIMARY: wait for checkout step 1 to load
wait: queued plan (3 steps): type "Full name"; type "Email"; click "Continue to review
click: Clicking Continue to review to reach the final order review page
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the final order review page to load
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'the names of any fees added on top of {{listed_price}}
wait: Waiting on the final order review page without placing the order

summary:
Opened the first product, AirWave Pro Earbuds, and recorded its listed price as $49.00.
Added the product to the cart without extras; an additional ShieldPlus Protection Plan was found in the cart and removed.
Continued through checkout using simple test information and reached the final order review page.
Stopped at the review page without entering payment details or placing an order.
The review page showed a final total of $56.49, including a Service & handling fee.
one_liner: reached the final order review page on the checkout site

listed_price.query: the displayed current price of the first product in the product price area
listed_price.condition: the displayed price of the first product is stored as {{listed_price}}
listed_price.human_description: Reading the displayed price of the first product

listed_price_2.query: the displayed current price of the first product in the product price area

listed_price_2.human_description: Reading the displayed price of the first product

cart_contains_unadded_items.query: whether the ShieldPlus Protection Plan is listed as an additional item in the cart
cart_contains_unadded_items.condition: the cart contains anything else you did not add
cart_contains_unadded_items.human_description: Checking for an additional item in the cart
cart_contains_unadded_items.subject: anything else you did not add in the cart

final_total.query: the order total amount in the review order summary
final_total.condition: the final order total shown on the review page is stored as {{final_total}}
final_total.human_description: Reading the final order total from the review summary

extra_fees.query: the names of fees in the review order summary that are added beyond the listed item price
extra_fees.condition: the names of any fees added on top of {{listed_price}} are stored as {{extra_fees}} (or "none")
extra_fees.human_description: Reading added fee names from the review summary
extra_fees.code_js: Array.from(el(9).querySelectorAll('.row')).filter(r => { const s = Array.from(r.children); return s.length === 2 && /^\$/.test(s[1].textContent.trim()) && !r.querySelector('[data-testid="order-total"]') && !/^(AirWave Pro Earbuds)/.test(s[0].textContent.trim()); }).map(r => r.children[0].textContent.trim()).join(', ') || 'none'
